subject: Refund requested for accidental annual upgrade
customer_message: I meant to renew monthly but got charged $348 for the annual Pro plan. Can I get a refund?
resolution: Confirmed the annual charge was an accidental selection at checkout within the last 24 hours. Issued a full refund of $348.00 to the original payment method and reverted the subscription to monthly Pro billing.

subject: Refund for duplicate charge
customer_message: I was charged twice this month for my Starter plan, $29 each. Please refund one of them.
resolution: Verified two identical $29.00 charges within 48 hours due to a failed webhook retry. Refunded the duplicate charge of $29.00; original subscription charge remains valid.

subject: Refund denied for used annual plan
customer_message: I want a refund for the remaining 9 months of my annual Business plan, that's around $675, I'm not using it anymore.
resolution: Per policy, annual plans are refundable in full only within 14 days of purchase. Customer was 5 months into the term. Escalated to billing lead; partial goodwill credit of $150 approved and refund request for the full $675 denied.

subject: Refund after downgrade confusion
customer_message: I downgraded from Business to Pro but was still charged the Business rate of $99, can I get that back?
resolution: Confirmed downgrade was submitted after the billing cycle had already generated the invoice. Refunded the $60 difference between Business ($99) and Pro ($39) for the affected cycle.

subject: Small refund for unused add-on
customer_message: I added the extra seats add-on by mistake, it's only $15, can you take it off and refund it?
resolution: Removed the extra-seats add-on immediately and refunded the prorated $15.00 charge to the original payment method within confidence policy (small amount, high certainty).

subject: Proration question after mid-cycle upgrade
customer_message: I upgraded from Starter to Pro on day 15 of a 30-day cycle, how was the $35 charge calculated?
resolution: Explained proration: remaining 15 days of Starter ($14.50 credit) applied against 15 days of Pro ($49.50), resulting in a net charge of $35.00, billed immediately at upgrade time.

subject: Proration credit larger than expected
customer_message: I downgraded from Business to Starter and got a $120 credit, is that normal?
resolution: Verified downgrade occurred on day 3 of a 30-day annual-equivalent cycle, resulting in a large unused-time credit of $120.00 applied to the next invoice, consistent with proration policy.

subject: No proration applied on plan swap
customer_message: I switched plans mid-month and wasn't charged or credited anything, is that a bug?
resolution: Confirmed the swap was between two plans at the same price point (lateral move), so proration correctly resulted in a net $0.00 adjustment. No bug found.

subject: Proration on annual-to-monthly switch
customer_message: I moved from annual Pro ($468/yr) to monthly Pro mid-term, how is that prorated?
resolution: Calculated remaining annual value (~$210 unused) applied as account credit, monthly Pro billing ($39/mo) began immediately using the credit balance first.

subject: Large proration dispute over $100
customer_message: My proration credit shows $340 short compared to what I calculated myself, need this reviewed.
resolution: Discrepancy exceeded the $100 confidence threshold for automated resolution; escalated to a billing specialist for manual ledger review. Specialist found a plan-change timestamp bug and corrected the credit.

subject: Card declined at renewal
customer_message: My renewal payment failed, it says my card was declined. What do I do?
resolution: Advised customer to update their card in Billing > Payment Methods and retry payment. Retry succeeded; service was not interrupted since it was within the 7-day grace period.

subject: Repeated payment failures, account at risk
customer_message: I've gotten three failed payment emails this week, is my account going to be suspended?
resolution: Explained the dunning process: 3 retry attempts over 7 days, then a 3-day grace period before suspension. Helped customer update expired card; next retry scheduled automatically.

subject: Payment failed due to insufficient funds
customer_message: My bank says the payment attempt failed for insufficient funds, will you keep trying?
resolution: Confirmed automatic retry is scheduled in 3 days per dunning schedule. Customer can also trigger an immediate retry manually from the billing page once funds are available.

subject: Bank flagged charge as fraud
customer_message: My bank blocked the charge thinking it was fraud, how do I fix this?
resolution: Advised customer to contact their bank to whitelist the merchant charge descriptor 'BILLINGCO*SUB', then retry payment from the billing dashboard.

subject: Currency mismatch causing decline
customer_message: My card is in EUR but the charge attempt shows USD and keeps failing.
resolution: Confirmed account billing currency was set to USD by default. Switched billing currency to EUR at customer's request; payment succeeded on next attempt.

subject: How to cancel subscription
customer_message: I want to cancel my subscription at the end of this billing cycle, how do I do that?
resolution: Walked customer through Settings > Subscription > Cancel Plan. Confirmed cancellation is scheduled for the end of the current paid cycle; access continues until then.

subject: Cancellation confirmation not received
customer_message: I cancelled last week but never got a confirmation email, did it actually go through?
resolution: Verified in the system that cancellation was processed successfully on the requested date. Resent the cancellation confirmation email; a delivery delay was the cause.

subject: Wants to cancel immediately, not at cycle end
customer_message: Can I cancel right now instead of waiting until the end of the month?
resolution: Explained that plans are non-refundable mid-cycle per policy, but immediate cancellation is possible on request; customer opted for immediate cancellation with access ending same day.

subject: Reactivating a cancelled account
customer_message: I cancelled two weeks ago but changed my mind, can I get my account back?
resolution: Reactivated the account on the previous plan tier (Pro). Since the account was inactive less than 30 days, no data was lost and no new setup fee applied.

subject: Cancellation due to unused seats
customer_message: We only use 2 of our 10 seats, should we cancel and start over on a smaller plan?
resolution: Recommended downgrading seat count instead of cancelling to preserve historical data and integrations; walked through seat-reduction flow instead of full cancellation.

subject: Upgrade from Starter to Business
customer_message: I want to upgrade from Starter to Business, what happens to my current billing date?
resolution: Confirmed upgrades take effect immediately and the billing date does not change; the price difference is prorated and charged right away.

subject: Downgrade takes effect at cycle end
customer_message: If I downgrade from Pro to Starter, does it happen right away or later?
resolution: Clarified that downgrades are scheduled for the end of the current billing cycle by default, so full access to Pro features continues until then, unless immediate downgrade is explicitly requested.

subject: Feature loss after downgrade
customer_message: Will I lose my saved reports if I downgrade from Business to Pro?
resolution: Explained that saved reports beyond the Pro plan's limit are archived (not deleted) for 90 days and become read-only; upgrading again within that window restores full access.

subject: Switching from monthly to annual
customer_message: Can I switch my Pro plan from monthly to annual billing to save money?
resolution: Switched billing frequency to annual Pro ($468/yr, equivalent to 2 months free vs monthly). Prorated credit for unused monthly days applied to the first annual invoice.

subject: Enterprise upgrade inquiry
customer_message: We're growing past 50 seats, can we move from Business to Enterprise?
resolution: Connected customer with the enterprise sales team for custom pricing and a contract, since Enterprise plans are not self-serve.

subject: Disputed line item on invoice
customer_message: My invoice has a $45 'API overage' charge I don't recognize.
resolution: Reviewed usage logs and confirmed the account exceeded the included API call quota by 15,000 calls, generating the $45.00 overage charge per the plan's published overage rate.

subject: Invoice total doesn't match quote
customer_message: Sales quoted me $199/month but my invoice says $249, a $50 difference. Can you look into it?
resolution: Discrepancy involved a signed sales quote; exceeded automated resolution scope. Escalated to billing lead who confirmed the quoted promotional rate and issued a $50.00 credit plus corrected future invoices.

subject: Large invoice dispute over VAT
customer_message: I was charged $210 in VAT I don't think applies to my business, need this reviewed.
resolution: Amount exceeded the $100 automatic-escalation threshold for invoice disputes; routed to the tax/billing specialist team for a VAT-exemption document review.

subject: Small rounding discrepancy on invoice
customer_message: My invoice shows $39.01 instead of $39.00, is that a bug?
resolution: Confirmed a $0.01 currency-conversion rounding artifact from EUR-to-USD conversion; no action needed, difference is within normal rounding tolerance.

subject: Duplicate line item on invoice
customer_message: My latest invoice lists the Pro plan charge twice, total looks like $78 instead of $39.
resolution: Confirmed a rendering bug duplicated the line item display only; actual charge processed was $39.00 (single charge). Corrected invoice PDF re-issued.

subject: How is sales tax determined?
customer_message: Why was I charged sales tax on my invoice this month but not last month?
resolution: Explained that sales tax is calculated based on the billing address on file and can change if tax nexus rules or the address changes; no error found on this account.

subject: VAT number not applied
customer_message: I added my VAT number but it's still not showing as removed on my invoice.
resolution: Found the VAT number was saved but not marked verified. Re-submitted for verification; VAT was correctly excluded starting with the next invoice.

subject: Past-due notice, what happens next
customer_message: I got a past-due notice, what happens if I don't pay in time?
resolution: Explained the dunning schedule: reminder emails on day 1 and 4, service restriction on day 7 if unresolved, and full suspension on day 14. Encouraged updating payment method to avoid interruption.

subject: Where to update billing email
customer_message: How do I change the email address that receives my invoices?
resolution: Directed customer to Settings > Billing > Billing Contact to update the invoice recipient email; change takes effect on the next billing event.

subject: Tax exemption certificate submission
customer_message: We're a registered non-profit, how do we submit a tax exemption certificate?
resolution: Provided the tax-exemption submission portal link and explained processing takes 3-5 business days; future invoices will exclude sales tax once approved.
